title: RealisticCraft
description: Taking Minecraft realism to the next level.
author: brynblack
body:
![RealisticCraft Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/625fe9fda054d62af65f5c1406852422c3954bf5_0.webp)

RealisticCraft is a Fabric modpack that brings realism to Minecraft, without drastically changing much of the underlying gameplay.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/l8npI6jLoWc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

It features:
- Atmospheric sound design
- Realistic game progression
- Many visual improvements
- A thirst and warmth system
- Redesigned combat mechanics
- Patches to unrealistic behaviour
- Many, many performance mods

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7zBMp9RO/images/01ac3296f671d57e7b009f1840524b908b656c1e.png)

versions.changelog:
- replaced NoisiumForked with Fast Noise [(suggested in this issue)](https://github.com/brynblack/RealisticCraft/issues/12)
- replaced Primity with Survivalist Essentials
- updated Minecraft version to 1.21.11
- updated all mods
- included default shader configuration and some mod options

versions.name: 1.2.0-alpha1
versions.changelog: Updated to Minecraft 1.21.10, changed out core mods. HEAVY WIP.
Hotfix for world taking much longer than normal to generate and fixed error spam in console.
Updated most mods to their latest versions, added support for shaders and added Makeup as the default shader, added Nyf's Spiders as requested by EllieJaybee and removed redundant mods.
Fixed a bug where you cannot progress, due to being unable to swing through grass with a flint knife or sword.
Updated all the mods, including the loader, and added a couple more. Namely, Better Combat and a few performance related mods.

Fixed thirst bar not being aligned properly and added a mod to make trees have snowy leaves when it snows. Also disabled FOV effects out of the box as your FOV in real life does not change when you sprint.
Added configurations for mods which had out-of-the-box defaults that caused issues or slight audio inconsistencies. Also configured default vanilla options to make experience better.
